verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover each part of the story. Board Consent and Stockholder Consent workflows draft written consents and solicit approvals, and generative workflows produce documents for execution on the platform. Signers get an emailed link and can sign by drawing, uploading or typing. Approvals are built into relevant workflows, and the resulting documents are filed automatically into a smart-linked data room, with award agreements tied to their board consent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration; explicit evidence that consents are linked to transactions other than option or award grants, such as financings or stockholder-approved actions.
